title: Skiers in Antarctica evacuated by black helicopters

tellings.quote: There have been skiers who have uh, you know, were putitively exploring Antarctica for sport who have had black helicopters descend on them

plain: Michels says that skiers who were supposedly exploring Antarctica just for sport have had black helicopters come down on them. He tells this himself, without naming a source or saying when it happened. The point, if true, is that someone is guarding parts of the frozen continent from visitors.
